title: Make * of symbolic vectors and matrices the product of the components, as numpy, and remove special.deprecations.symbolicStarProduct
author: Claude-JG
description: * of two symbolic vectors (or with a matrix) raises a TypeError since the issue before, so that scripts change to dot(), @ and multiply(); in about two to three years, when the problems have shown up, * becomes the component-wise product as in numpy, and the deprecation flag symbolicStarProduct is removed.
workingRemarks: Delayed on purpose: the plan step RG12.6 is closed, the issue waits for its deadline 2029-01-01.; deferred until 2029-01-01 (Claude-JG, 2026-10-17): * of symbolic vectors becomes the product of the components once the scripts that used it for the scalar product have shown up through the TypeError of #3015
